264.title: Certification of obligations
paragraphs: Art. 264. (1) The transfer or creation of real rights in real estate or of inheritance rights that include real estate, the contribution of real estate or real rights in it as non-monetary contributions to the capital of companies, and the entry of a mortgage or special pledge are allowed after an electronic check at the National Revenue Agency by the notary, the registration judge, the registration officer under the Commercial Register Act or the officer under the Special Pledges Act shows that the transferor or grantor of the real rights, the mortgage debtor or the pledgor has no unpaid public debts subject to enforcement. Whether there are unpaid taxes on the property is certified in the tax assessment.

(2) Ownership of motor vehicles is transferred after a check in the information exchange system of the Ministry of Finance under Art. 5a of the Local Taxes and Fees Act that the vehicle tax is paid, and after an electronic check at the National Revenue Agency by the notary or the registration officer that the transferor has no unpaid public debts subject to enforcement. When the municipality has not ensured continuous automated exchange, the vehicle tax check may be made on a document issued or certified by the municipality.

(4) When a notary or registration judge finds that the persons under paras. 1 and 2 have public debts, the acts may be performed after the debts are paid, or if the debtor declares in writing that he agrees his public debts be paid from the sum for the transfer or creation of the real right, and the buyer pays the sum due into the relevant budget.
(5) Acts under paras. 1 and 2 performed in breach of para. 4 cannot be relied upon against the state and the municipality.
